full_prompt_en: The image is a square decorative print-like illustration of a huge orange crescent above blue trees and a quiet lake. A nearly black star-speckled sky fills the upper and central background. Across it, a broad burnt-orange crescent curves from the top center down toward the lower middle and back up to the upper right, with dense fine dots and short etched marks covering its surface. A smaller pale gold moon overlaps the crescent near the upper left. At the far left, another golden textured mass enters from beyond the frame. Rounded dark teal tree crowns rise in the foreground at both sides, attached to branching warm brown trunks. The left tree is taller and more open, its limbs visible among clustered blue foliage; the right tree forms a broad heavy canopy that hides part of the crescent. Below them, a narrow turquoise lake stretches across the lower middle, edged by small blue shrubs, ochre grasses, and orange blossoms. A low island or bank slopes into the water from the right. Small white birds fly above the water and near the dark center of the crescent. The horizon is low and flat, but the dense vegetation gives the foreground intricate depth. Pale highlights on the birds and moon punctuate the otherwise dark scene. The light is fantastical and even, with orange and gold areas glowing against the black sky rather than casting realistic shadows. Fine stippling and etched line work texture every colored field, while the large arcs and rounded canopies keep the forms legible. The whole composition balances warm celestial curves with cool organic masses and a thin calm band of water.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、带装饰版画感的插画：巨大的橙色弯月悬在蓝色树木和静湖上方。近黑而有星点的天空填满上部及中部背景。其上，一道宽大的焦橙色弯月从顶部中央弯向下方中部，再回升到右上，表面密布细点和短刻痕。一轮较小的浅金月亮在左上附近压住弯月。最左侧，另一块金色纹理团从画外进入。两侧前景有圆团状深青绿树冠升起，接在暖棕分枝树干上。左树较高也较疏，枝桠在成簇蓝叶间可见；右树形成宽而沉重的树冠，遮住部分弯月。其下，一道窄青绿湖面横过下方中部，边缘是小蓝灌木、赭色草和橙花。一块低岛或岸从右侧斜入水中。小白鸟飞在水面上和弯月暗心附近。地平线低而平，但密实植被给前景复杂纵深。鸟和月上的浅亮点刺破整体暗场。光带幻想感而均匀，橙与金色区域在黑天空前发亮，而不投出写实阴影。细点彩与刻线纹理覆盖每片色场，大弧和圆树冠仍使形状清楚可读。整幅构图让暖色天体曲线与冷有机团块、一道细细的平静水带相平衡。
style_prompt_en: Decorative print-like illustration places monumental warm arcs and pale circles against a nearly black speckled field. Burnt orange and gold carry dense stippled texture, while deep teal and blue-green form rounded masses and a narrow horizontal band below. Brown branching lines and fine etched marks add intricate local rhythm inside broad simple shapes. Small white flecks provide sharp accents at widely spaced points. Light is symbolic and even: warm areas appear luminous through contrast, with little natural cast shadow. The surface feels engraved and grainy, yet silhouette boundaries stay strong. Large curves overtake the upper space while small repeated marks gather near the lower edge, making a balanced, slightly fantastical stillness.
style_prompt_zh: 装饰版画式插画把巨大的暖色弧与浅色圆放在近黑的斑点色场前。焦橙与金色承载密集点彩纹理，深青与蓝绿在下方形成圆团和窄横带。棕色分枝线与细刻痕在宽大简洁形状内部增加繁密局部节奏。稀疏间隔的小白点提供尖锐点缀。光具有象征性且均匀：暖色区域靠对比发亮，几乎没有自然投影。表面像刻印一样有颗粒，剪影边界仍有力。大曲线占住上部空间，小重复记号聚在下缘，形成平衡而略带幻想的静止感。
theme_en: A huge orange crescent above blue trees and a quiet lake
theme_zh: 巨大的橙色弯月悬在蓝色树木和静湖上方
name: Don Blanding
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
